svg.aria-label: Open source. Four fixes merged into Webots, an open-source robot simulator, in WREN, its C++ rendering engine. #7048: Merge identical vertices of WREN static meshes. #7047: Do not build mesh normals while loading a world. #7043: Fix stale camera culling after reading a WREN matrix. #7036: Fix duplicate light intensity scaling in PBR diffuse lighting.
